title.zh: 复现不用可判定性：有限家族中开始成立复现时不再成立永不终止，反之亦然；在所寻之处已定时找到那一步，从某步起已定时二者同时复现
title.en: Recurrence with no decidedness: in a finite family, where coming to be recurs ceasing never stops for good, and conversely; decided where it is sought the step is found, and decided from some step on the two recur together

claim.zh: 有限家族中，没有东西不再成立时，每个成员至多开始成立一次（comes_once）；没有东西开始成立时，每个成员至多不再成立一次（ceases_once_of）。所以一段中看到成员开始成立、或不再成立的不同步数不多于成员数（coming_steps_within、ceasing_steps_within）。由此，开始成立复现时，从每一步起都有一段，其中有东西不再成立不能被否证（Recurs.ceasing_within），不再成立永不终止：从某步起再没有不再成立被否证（Recurs.ceasing_not_stopping）；反之亦然（Recurs.coming_within、Recurs.coming_not_stopping）。不用可判定性。那一段的状态已定时，那一步被找到（Recurs.ceasing_found、Recurs.coming_found）；从某步起已定时，开始成立复现恰当不再成立复现（coming_recurs_iff_decided），不要判定程序，而 coming_recurs_iff 在每一步都要求判定程序。依存网中形成有限多时亦然（Web.unceasing_iff_decided）。有限世界中，生起复现时止息永不终止，反之亦然，不用可判定性（World.ceasing_not_stopping、World.arising_not_stopping）；从某步起已定时生起复现恰当止息复现（World.arising_iff_ceasing_decided），World.arising_iff_ceasing 是由判定程序从第一步起已定的情形（World.arising_iff_ceasing_of_decidable）；有一个列表从某步起覆盖活跃者时亦然，已定只问列表的成员（World.ceasing_not_stopping_covered、World.arising_not_stopping_covered、World.arising_iff_ceasing_covered）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: In a finite family, while nothing of it ceases each member comes to be at most once (comes_once), and while nothing comes to be each ceases at most once (ceases_once_of); so no more steps of a stretch see a member come to be, or cease, than the family has members (coming_steps_within, ceasing_steps_within). Hence, where coming to be recurs, from any step there is a stretch in which something ceasing cannot be refuted (Recurs.ceasing_within), and ceasing never stops for good: that from some step on nothing ceases is refuted (Recurs.ceasing_not_stopping); and conversely (Recurs.coming_within, Recurs.coming_not_stopping). No decidedness is used. With the states of that stretch decided, the step is found (Recurs.ceasing_found, Recurs.coming_found); decided from some step on, coming to be recurs exactly where ceasing does (coming_recurs_iff_decided), with no decision procedure, where coming_recurs_iff asks one at every step. The same holds of a web with finitely many formations (Web.unceasing_iff_decided). In a finite world, where arising recurs ceasing never stops for good, and conversely, with no decidedness (World.ceasing_not_stopping, World.arising_not_stopping); decided from some step on, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does (World.arising_iff_ceasing_decided), World.arising_iff_ceasing being the case decided by a procedure from the first step (World.arising_iff_ceasing_of_decidable); with a list covering what is active from some step on the same holds, decidedness asked only of the list's members (World.ceasing_not_stopping_covered, World.arising_not_stopping_covered, World.arising_iff_ceasing_covered). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 不终止的形式：家族有限（一个列表覆盖它），不要求可判定。
hypotheses.en: The forms that never stop: the family is finite (a list covers it), with no decidedness.

hypotheses.zh: 找到一步的形式：所寻那一段的状态已定；同时复现的形式：从某步起已定。
hypotheses.en: The forms finding a step: the states of the stretch searched decided; the forms recurring together: decided from some step on.

correspondence.zh: Ren 2026-10-11：“give me more context, but i intuitively feel decidability is too dualist, also proved solutions and their pro/cons”，并以“please”接受 AI 的建议：可判定性局部化，不再是表示的承诺。AI 的读法：不终止的形式是双重否定的复现，不指出在哪一步，但排除“从某步起再没有”；这正是已证的界：不给已定时，命名一步需要有限全知原则（World.lpo_of_finite_ends、Listed.lpo_of_few、Web.lpo_of_ending），对每个有限世界要求复现需要排中律（World.law_iff_em）。读法待 Ren。
correspondence.en: Ren, 11 October 2026: “give me more context, but i intuitively feel decidability is too dualist, also proved solutions and their pro/cons”, and “please” to the AI's suggestion that decidability be made local, no longer a commitment of the representation. The AI's reading: the forms that never stop are recurrence doubly negated, naming no step but excluding “none from some step on”; this is the proved boundary: without decidedness, naming a step needs the limited principle of omniscience (World.lpo_of_finite_ends, Listed.lpo_of_few, Web.lpo_of_ending), and asking recurrence of every finite world needs excluded middle (World.law_iff_em). The reading awaits Ren.

detail.zh: 复用开始成立与不再成立（ComesToBe、CeasesToBe）与家族中的复现（Recurs）。
detail.en: Reuses coming to be and ceasing (ComesToBe, CeasesToBe) and recurrence in a family (Recurs).

output.zh: 开始成立、不再成立与其复现；有限家族中，以判定程序，一方复现恰当另一方复现（coming_recurs_iff）。
output.en: Coming to be, ceasing and their recurrence; in a finite family, with a decision procedure, each recurs exactly when the other does (coming_recurs_iff).

input.zh: 同一规律不用判定程序：永不终止的形式，以及从某步起已定时的形式。
input.en: The same law with no decision procedure: the forms that never stop, and the form decided from some step on.

detail.zh: 复用世界、有限、生起复现与止息复现（World、World.Finite、World.ArisingRecurs、World.CeasingRecurs）。
detail.en: Reuses worlds, finiteness, and arising and ceasing recurring (World, World.Finite, World.ArisingRecurs, World.CeasingRecurs).

output.zh: 世界与其复现；活动可判定的有限世界中生起复现恰当止息复现（World.arising_iff_ceasing）。
output.en: Worlds and their recurrence; in a finite world whose activity is decided, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does (World.arising_iff_ceasing).

input.zh: 有限世界中不要求可判定时的形式与从某步起已定时的形式。
input.en: For finite worlds, the forms without decidedness and the form decided from some step on.

conditions.zh: 有限世界，或从某步起覆盖活跃者的列表。
conditions.en: A finite world, or a list covering what is active from some step on.

detail.zh: 同一模块：计数作为关系。
detail.en: The same module: counting as a relation.

detail.zh: 那里每条变化规律不加前提，无损恰当在有限构形中返回；这里有限家族的复现不加可判定性。
detail.en: There every law of change, with no premise, is lossless exactly when it returns within finite configurations; here the recurrence of a finite family needs no decidedness.

detail.zh: 那里一个列表从某步起覆盖活跃者时，止息复现使此后每一步之后的生起都不能被否证（Covers.not_not_coming_from）；这里有这样的列表时，复现的不终止形式，以及只问列表成员已定的规律。
detail.en: There, with a list covering what is active from some step on, ceasing recurring leaves a later arising unrefuted after every step (Covers.not_not_coming_from); here, with such a list, the forms of recurrence that never stop, and the law asking decidedness only of the list's members.

detail.zh: undecided 世界（World.undecided）有限，生起复现（World.undecided_world）；要求每个有限世界中生起复现给出止息复现的规律，在 undecided Q 上判定任一命题 Q（World.law_decides），所以对每个有限世界要求确切的复现规律而不给已定，就是排中律（World.law_iff_em）；不终止的形式不要求已定。
detail.en: The undecided world (World.undecided) is finite, with arising recurring (World.undecided_world); a law giving ceasing recurring from arising recurring in every finite world decides any proposition Q at undecided Q (World.law_decides), so asking the exact recurrence law of every finite world without decidedness is excluded middle (World.law_iff_em); the forms that never stop ask no decidedness.

limitations.zh: 不终止的形式不指出在哪一步；命名一步需要所寻之处已定，对每个世界要求复现需要从某步起已定；只对离散步陈述；读法是 AI 的，待 Ren。
limitations.en: The forms that never stop name no step; naming one needs decidedness where it is sought, and asking recurrence of every world needs decidedness from some step on; stated for discrete steps; the readings are the AI's, pending Ren.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261012T012916.201078Z）：Becoming.Decidedness 的 55 项定理全部空依赖；同一回执覆盖包内 57 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 2970 项定理／4334 项声明审计，15 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致；外围回执 20261012T013048.258651Z 通过。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 59 个模块，其中每条源声明的公理报告为空（Lean 生成的常量中，只有带字段构造子的单射引理 injEq 依赖 propext，没有源声明使用它们，检查器逐一列出），并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。作者反审见整合文档 §84；尚未经独立审查。
validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261012T012916.201078Z): the 55 theorems of Becoming.Decidedness all have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 57 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 2970 theorems/4334 declaration audits, and 15 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261012T013048.258651Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 59 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §84 of the integration note; not yet independently reviewed.

next_delta.zh: 以不终止的形式重述其余只在证明中用到可判定性的复现规律（清点页逐条列出理由）；Ren 对读法的确认。
next_delta.en: Restating the other recurrence laws that use decidedness only in their proofs in the forms that never stop (the inventory page gives each one's reason); Ren's confirmation of the reading.
